svg.text: Dark-mode desktop concept / shared navigation shell / forecasting and inventory workflows
History and forecast in one view
Search items and review stock status
Connect an approved inventory source to populate quantities and thresholds.
Unknown values stay blank; the interface will not invent stock quantities.
Compare observed demand with the projected trend
Solid line = observed demand. Dashed line and shaded region = projection and uncertainty window.
Review suggested actions before any purchase decision
Recommendations are advisory. No order is placed automatically from this screen.
Conceptual wireframes • all quantities and live status fields are placeholders until approved data sources are connected.
